scope: Local implementation freeze only; no new experimental outcomes

IRN.use: Observe real receiver ECN versus gap-generated CNP separately; observe nonempty SACK inside active requests, then drained state after cumulative ACK.
IRN.condition: This simulator releases no bytes of a future round before prior cumulative ACK.
IRN.difference: Tests the existing ns-3 implementation and its own SACK discard logic; no RNIC or FPGA implementation evidence.

Flowcut.use: Use explicit acknowledged/drained boundaries before changing tuple state.
Flowcut.condition: Fixture waits for all released bytes before reuse or cleanup.
Flowcut.difference: No Flowcut ACK accounting or window routing mechanism is implemented, and no Flowcut performance transfers.

SeqBalance.use: Distinguish QP lifetime from request completion and avoid representing fresh QPs as persistence.
SeqBalance.condition: One persistent sender/receiver object with cumulative sequence, separate request origins.
SeqBalance.difference: No WQE driver or parent/sub-QP/CQE implementation; cannot claim verbs transparency or real connection-pool behavior.

ConWeave.version: SIGCOMM 2023 fixed local final PDF; native reference 236a801a00e35de9078635e04acae2f701c21ded
ConWeave.use: Observe actual INIT/TAIL, epoch/phase, reply matching, queue buffering and release; retain native timers.
ConWeave.condition: Passive hooks only, followed by required off/on regression before scientific use.
ConWeave.difference: No simplified Gemma or modified ConWeave logic; static equality after hook removal does not replace native build or dynamic regression.

remaining: All native builds, physical trigger coverage and observer invariance are pending main-chat authorization.
